Read CBOR from a file or connection

Source: R/read.R
cbor_read.Rd

Reads the input and decodes it as cbor_decode() or cbor_decode_seq() would. At most max_size + 1 bytes are ever read, so an oversized file or an endless connection fails with zucbor_size_limit rather than exhausting memory.

Usage

cbor_read(file, ..., max_size = 64 * 1024^2)

cbor_read_seq(file, ..., max_size = 64 * 1024^2)

Arguments

file

A file path, a URL, or a connection.

...

Arguments passed on to cbor_decode() or cbor_decode_seq().

max_size

Largest input allowed, in bytes, or Inf.

Value

As cbor_decode() or cbor_decode_seq().

Details

A string with an http, https, ftp, ftps or file scheme is read with url(), any other string as a file path. A connection that is not open is opened in "rb" mode and closed afterwards; an open one must be binary, is read from its current position, and is left open.

Examples

path <- tempfile(fileext = ".cbor")
writeBin(as.raw(c(0xa1, 0x61, 0x61, 0x01)), path)
cbor_read(path)
#> $a
#> [1] 1
#> 
unlink(path)
